python3 -c 'import sys,json,re,statistics as st,subprocess,tarfile,datetime
from pathlib import Path
f=Path(sys.argv[1])
a=[]
for d in f.glob("*-V3A1-18-a[123]*"):
 p=d/"server-log.txt"
 if not p.exists():continue
 m=re.search(r'"'"'(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d\.\d+) UTC[^\n]*automatic [^\n]*vacuum[^\n]*"bench.public.crit"(.*?)(?=\n\d{4}-|\Z)'"'"',p.read_text(),re.S)
 if m:
  end=datetime.datetime.strptime(m[1],"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f").replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp()
  a.append(end-float(re.search(r"elapsed: ([0-9.]+) s",m[2])[1])-float((d/"t0").read_text()))
print(st.median(a))' "$F"
